balls.text: a helicopter shot to end the innings with. Harshal misses the yorker and ends up bowling it almost in the slot. Varma gets under it and uses his wrists to whip it over long-on
a full toss on the pads. Hit towards deep midwicket, one bounce to the fielder. The batters were looking for the second initially but then change their mind
a no-ball for height now. RCB have challenged the call. It was outside off, and Varma manages to hit it towards cover-point for one. The ball-tracking shows it was well over the waist height

a bouncer but Varma is in such good touch that he manages to find a gap despite not looking in a great position. Rolled his wrists over it to keep it down and send it between the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket
a wide full toss. Arshad was looking to hit it through the off side but ends up dragging it towards long-on
short of length and it looked as if Arshad was just waiting for it. Pulls it over deep midwicket for a six
full on the pads. Clipped to the left of deep midwicket for a couple
full and wide outside off. Varma throws his bat at it but fails to connect. Was very close to being called yet another wide
short of length at the stumps, and Varma pulls it behind square leg. Picks up another boundary
Siraj seems to have lost his radar here. Full but way, way outside off. Fifth wide of the over
down the track to this length ball, and just lofts it to the left of mid-off. Eleven off the over with two balls to go
full around off. Varma goes for the big shot down the ground but ends up mistiming it to the left of long-on. Comes back for the second
and another one - four wides in a row. This one was full but way outside off once more
a hat-trick of wides. Short and way outside off. Varma was lacking to help it on its way but he cannot reach there
length but this one is even wider. Varma doesn't even attempt a shot this time
short of length and angling across, but well outside off. Varma fails to connect the cut. Called a wide
length outside off. Throws his bat at it and the ball dribbles towards deep-backward point
length ball, just outside off. Arshad goes for the pull but is beaten, by pace I think
slashed to the point boundary. Was a length ball but enough room to free the arms. Varma doesn't miss out
a dipping slower one. Full outside off and Varma fails to pick, and connect, it
length ball at the batter, cramping him. Varma goes for the flick but misses. Was there an inside edge? Not sure but they run one
another full toss. Mistimes the pull to the left of long-on who makes a good stop. Two more to the total
a length ball but way, way outside off. Karthik too fumbles behind the stumps, and the batter run one, in addition to the wide
a dipping full toss around off. A mistimed pull towards deep midwicket to open his account

an excellent catch by du Plessis. It was full around off from Harshal, Shokeen looked to chip it over mid-off but du Plessis ran sideways to his left, keeping his eyes on the ball. He judged it perfectly and timed his jump well to pouch it with both hands over his shoulder. Completed the catch by tumbling over

a low full toss at the stumps. Varma was looking to hit it over midwicket but gets a leading edge. Lands safe behind the bowler, and the batters complete two before the fielder in the deep sends in the throw
a bouncer. Varma goes for the pull, gets a top edge and it flies over the keeper's head

full but way outside off. Varma was moving across but lets it go through the keeper. RCB want to review the wide call. Varma was standing deep and just outside off, and the TV umpire reckons the ball was within his reach. So the wide call has been changed
full around off. Looks to digs it out and ends up mistiming it towards short midwicket
short of length outside off. Looks to ramp it but fails to connect
challenge accepted, Varma says. A length ball from Akash Deep and he launches it over deep square leg for a 78-metre six. Gets to his fifty as well, off 32 balls
length but down the leg side. An almost falling pull to send it to the fine-leg boundary
length ball on the stumps. Flicked towards square leg for one more
length ball on the stumps. Flicked towards square leg, and Shokeen was looking for the second. Sent back by his partner
huge, huge wicket. Full on the stumps. David goes for the slog sweep but misses it altogether. The ball clatters into the stumps
length ball outside off and spinning away. Left alone for a wide
full on the stumps. Digs it out towards deep midwicket. The call was for two but Prabhudessai keeps it to one
length ball around off. Goes back and cuts it towards deep extra cover
a sharp bouncer to end the over with. Varma wasn't expecting it and sways away from it
a short ball but it comes slower off the surfaces. Mistimes the pull towards deep square leg
length outside off, punched firmly but the extra cover fielder makes a good stop to his left
length ball around off. David misjudged the length but checked his shot at the last moment. As a result, it doesn't carry to the bowler
full on the pads, flicked towards square leg
length ball around off. Driven towards long-on
a length ball on the stumps, looked like a quicker one. David goes back, clears his front leg and punches it towards long-on
third time unlucky. Full on the stumps, Wadhera goes for another big hit but fails to get under it this time. Ends up hitting straight towards Kohli at long-on
and he goes again. Over the roof - 101 metres. Was right in the slot this time. Slightly fuller than good length outside off and Wadhera launches it over long-on. He is pumped up
slightly short of length and Wadhera takes full advantage of this. Rocks back and smashes it over deep midwicket
full on the pads. Goes for the slog sweep but misses. Gets pinged on the pads
full on the stumps. flicked towards deep midwicket. Varma was looking for the second but sent back by his partner
full around off. Digs it out past the bowler, didn't time it though. Just a single down the ground
short and pulled down towards deep square leg for one more
length ball on the stumps, flicked towards deep square leg
a short ball this time, angling across. Varma goes for the pull but misses
length ball around off. Hits it straight towards extra cover, and he isn't happy with himself
a length ball on the stumps. Varma goes down on one knee and looks to scoop it fine. It doesn't go where he intended. The ball carries on with the angle and goes over the short third for four
length outside off, cut away. Siraj with a tumbling stop in the deep. He fires in the throw to the keeper who breaks the stumps. We are going upstairs... Wadhera was well in
use of feet from Varma once again but fails to middle it. He was looking to hit it over extra cover but gets an inside edge towards midwicket
length on the stumps. Goes for the sweep but misses. It was sliding down the leg. They pick up a leg-bye to short fine leg
length outside off, steered through cover-point

length ball outside off and spinning away. Varma was first looking to cut it away but withdraws the shot in the end. Called a wide, and Maxwell isn't happy with it. A harsh call and I think Maxwell forgot he can review those now
short of length outside off. Varma goes back and pulls it to the right of deep midwicket
starts with a fuller ball on the stumps. Varma dances down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head for a six
length ball at the stumps, cramping the batter who was looking to cut it away. Chopped towards covers
length outside off. Goes back and cuts it behind point. A fumble in the deep but it doesn't cost RCB
full around off. Uses of feet but ends up pushing it towards cover-point
length ball at the stumps. Backs away and looks to run it between the keeper and short third but ends up chopping it into the ground
full on the stumps, pushes at it and gets an inside edge past the stumps. Comes back for the second
here's the reverse hit he was looking to play on the last ball of the previous over. Full on the stumps and Varma hits it over point for four. No one in the deep
length ball around off. Goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover. Was initially shaping up for a reverse hit
length ball on the stumps, flicked towards short midwicket for a quick single. The bowler fields himself

an appeal for lbw but not given. RCB want to review this. Was a length ball around leg stump. Wadhera looked to flick it away but missed and got hit on the front pad, near knee roll. The ball-tracking shows it pitched just outside leg, so RCB lose their review
a googly. A length ball around off, Wadhera was looking to work it on the leg side but the ball hardly goes anywhere
full on the stumps. Opens the face of the bat to slice it towards covers
full around off. Down the ground and drills it towards long-off
and he gets off the mark in T20 cricket with a boundary. Was a length ball outside off and Wadhera opened the face of the bat to steer it past the slip fielder. Fifty also comes up for Mumbai
short of length outside off. Surya goes for the cut but ends up hitting it straight to Shahbaz at backward point. It was at an awkward height but Shahbaz leapt in the air and took it comfortably
full and wide outside off. Surya goes over covers and beats the man in the deep. It was Siraj who put in a slide to his right, got the hand on it but couldn't flick it back
length outside off and spinning in big, and sharply. Surya was shaping up for a cut but is cramped. Ends up slicing it towards short third
length ball around off. Goes back and whip it towards deep midwicket
length outside off. Finds point with the cut
length ball on the pads. Missed the flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball goes towards backward point where the fielder charges in to prevent any leg-byes
short of length on the stumps. Pulled toward deep midwicket. Virat runs to his left and keeps it to one
tossed up on the stumps. Surya comes forward and hits it towards long-on for one

Topley is down, and holding is right shoulder. He looks in absolute pain. It was full on the stumps. Varma came out of his crease and looked to flick it away, only to mistime it towards short fine. Topley ran in from backward square leg and dived to make the stop but in the process ended up hurting himself. He is walking off the field, still holding is shoulder. This is not a good sign for RCB. They don't have Hazlewood available either
full on the stumps, whipped through covers for one

too full on the stumps. Surya digs it out wide of long-on. Faf and Shahbaz Ahemd from deep midwicket converge and it looked like there could be another collision but both players slowed down with du Plessis kicking the ball back and Shahabz sending in the throw
a length ball, just outside off. Was bowled from wide of the crease. Surya looks to go aerial but fails to middle it. It bounces to the right of du Plessis at mid-off who makes a diving stop
a slower one. Length outside off, in the channel. Surya goes for the cut but fails to connect. Was back of the hand and landing on the seam
length ball on the stumps, tucked away towards midwicket
short of length and straying down the leg side. Varma pulls it to the right of short fine leg for four
length outside off. Surya opens the face of the bat to steer it towards deep third
full outside off, pushed towards sweeper cover
length outside off. Surya comes forward and pushes it past short third. Topley sprints in from deep point and puts in a slide to keep it to two
length ball outside off. Dabbed towards deep third
first six of the match. A length ball around off and cleared his front leg and smashed it into the stands beyond long-on
length ball angling across the left-hander. Pushed towards point
The drop doesn't prove costly. Was a length ball outside off and Rohit pushed at it without moving his feet. The ball seamed away to take the outside edge. Karthik accepted it gleefully
an excellent save by Topley, diving to his right at short third. Was a full outside off and Surya threw his bat at it. He will pick up a single, though
full on the stumps, driven towards mid-on

A bouncer from Siraj, Rohit goes for a pull but only gets a top edge. The ball balloons straight up, and both Siraj and Karthik go for the catch. Karthik calls for it, it's closer to him and he has got the big gloves. But both players collide and the chance goes down. Siraj is lying on the ground, a couple of players checking in on him. He is speaking, and looks fine. Yes, he is back on his feet and ready for the next ball
down the ground but Siraj bowls this on a hard length and at the batter. Rohit goes for a pull but the ball sneaks underneath his bat. Goes between his body and the stumps
length ball around off. Another solid punches, this time down the ground but Siraj bends low and gets his left hand on it. That's enough to stop the ball
length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot but fails to beat Bracewell at extra cover
length ball, angling towards off and middle. Surya works it towards square leg
length but way down the leg side. Needs to be bowled again
length ball around off, punched towards mid-off for a quick single. Off the mark
length outside off, punched to the right of the point fielder who makes a tumbling stop
a length ball around off, defended towards covers
bowled 'im! Full and straight, 137.1kph. Green looks to go hard but all he manages is an inside edge. It hit the bat on the full and crashed into the stumps
length ball on the pads but Green fails to connect the flick. Gets hit on the pads
length outside off and Green crashes this through covers for four
slightly fuller and just a little bit closer to the off stump. Defended back
length ball around off, stays leg side of the ball and defends it towards covers
length ball around off, driven on the up towards mid-off for a quick single
taken at deep third. That's the pressure of two dot balls. Was a length ball at the stumps and Kishan looked to pick it up over square leg only to get an outside edge that flew to Harshal
great line and length from Siraj. Cramps Kishan once again and hits him on the body. Kishan was looking to jab at it
length ball on the stumps. Kishan misses the flick and is hit on the pads. An appeal from Siraj but think it landed just outside leg
length outside off, steered behind point for one
smashed again but straight to the cover fielder this time
too much room outside off this time and Kishan slashes it through covers for another boundary

a direct hit and Rohit would have been out. Was full outside off and Kishan hit to the right of Bracewell at covers. Kishan a took a couple of steps down the ground but Bracewell dived across to make the stop. Still off balance, he tried for a direct hit at the bowler's end but missed. Rohit would have been out by miles
length ball around off, defended towards covers
full and wide outside off. Kishan stretches and throws his bat at it, sending the ball for four through covers
length outside off. Rohit was on the front foot and opens the face of the bat to guide it towards point. Kishan was looking for a single but Rohit sends him back
length ball outside off. Kishan steers it behind point and gets off the mark
full on the stumps. Comes forward and defends it towards short midwicket
length ball on the pads, goes for the flick but misses. Gets hit on the leg
short of length around off, steered towards cover-point
short of length on middle and leg. Rohit tucks it down towards deep backward square leg

In the arc, out of the park as Kohli finishes it off in style!  Right in the slot for Kohli outside off stump. He keeps his shape and sends it soaring over long on. He pumps the air in delight and hugs Maxwell. RCB have gunned the target down in 16.2 overs.
Banged in short outside off but that was way too high. Called a wide.
On a length on off, he Kohli cracks it past short fine leg and RCB are in a hurry
Six more! Another short of a length ball, shoulder-high. Maxwell backs away, clears his front leg and despite not getting all of it on the pull gets it over deep fine leg.
Oh, that is some shot to get off the mark! Banged in short outside off, he clears his front leg and smacks it over extra cover
Slower back of a length ball, he backs away looking for a pull, completely mistimes it to long on.

Flicked straight to deep square leg and Green has his first IPL wicket! Length on middle, he gets across and gets a good chunk on that. But couldn't find the gap, unfortunately. Tilak makes no mistake.
On a length outside off, Karthik looks for a big heave, the ball hits the toe-end of his bat and goes it to mid-off
Shin-high full toss to start with on middle stump, as Kohli gets across and works to deep backward square leg
Full-length ball outside off, driven hard back at the bowler, who misfields but no harm done

Slower length ball that is ballooned straight up and David ain't dropping those! Angled across Faf, who is not able to get the pace off the surface. Loses his shape and ends up lofting the ball to long-on.
Low full toss on off, he pushes it to long on
Banged in short now, he fails to connect the pull. Stifle appeal from Kishan to no avail.

In the aiiir, and put down by Shokeen at deep midwicket! That went flat and very hard, but should have been held. Length on middle and leg, he whips it straight to the fielder, who was late it picking the ball up as he ran in
In the slot for Kohli on off stump as he stays in his crease and lays into him by absolutely smashing him over wide long-on. This has been statement of sorts from Kohli.
banged in short again outside off, he bunts it to point almost nonchalantly
Low full toss outside off, he misses out as he drives it straight to mid-off
Another back of a length ball on the stump, he pulls it to deep midwicket.
Gets in position and hammers Archer for another maximum! Slower short of  a length ball aimed at the body of Kohli who gets inside the line and helps it over deep fine leg
Slower length ball outside off, he works it towards midwicket
Back of a length ball outside off, he stays legside of it and cuts it hard to the left of deep point
Full-length ball outside off, he was looking to loft that over extra cover, but the ball catches a bit of his of outside edge to deep cover
Low full toss that is hit back to the non-striker's stumps. The ball ricochets towards extra cover
No stopping Faf today!  The length ball is sprayed down the leg as he flicks past short fine leg.
WALLOPED! Banged in short on off, but that just sat up for Faf who gets into position nice and early and smacks the bowler over deep backward square leg.
Gets a bit of a leading edge does Kohli this time around. Length ball on off, he shimmies down the track, closes the face of the bat a touch early as the ball goes to long off.
Welcomes him to the crease with a four. Goes down the track to the short of a length ball and pulls it past long on.
Back of a hand slower ball into the surface. Faf can only mistime his hack back to the bowler

Fifty off 38 balls for Kohli and a knock of the highest order from the talisman! Back of a length ball on off, he pats it to the right of the bowler with soft hands. Raises his bat as Chinnaswamy roars in delight. 50th IPL fifty for Kohli.
Tries the bouncer now, Kohli pulls out off the hook. He was looking for a wide, but the umpire calls it one for the over. I felt that was quite high
Slower, back of the hand stuff outside off. He waits for it and opens the face of the bat to the right of deep cover.
Length ball that did not bouncer as much as expected. He can only bunt it towards the bowler.

Back of a length ball outside off, he works the ball with soft hands to long on and they take two. Oh, there is a terrific direct hit from David from the deep. The third umpire has been called for, but Faf had made it easily.
Gets down to play the slog sweep now, does not time it as well but finds the gap between long on and deep midwicket.
Full-length ball outside off, was quicker as well as he bunts it to point
Fuller outside off, he pushes it to long off
Going, going, gone! That is a shot and a half! Right in his arc on middle, he swings through the line and deposits Chawla over long on. The third 100-run stand between the duo in IPL
Tossed up full-length ball outside off, Kohli whacks it back at the stumps as the ball ricochets towards wide long on. They take two. Chawla could not get a finger on that
Flatter outside off, he pats it to point
Waits for the goof length ball on middle and leg and turns it to deep midwicket
Works the length ball towards deep midwicket
Two in two. This was right in the slot for du Plessis on off, as he clears his front leg, and swings through the line to slam him over long on
Fifty for Faf du Plessis, 26th in IPL, third against Mumbai.And what a way to get there. Length on off, right in the arc for the batter who hammers him over wide long on
Length on off, he pushes to long on
Slants the length ball on middle and leg as Kohli brings out the sweep and hoicks it to the right of Varma at deep backward square leg. The fielder does really well to save two.
Flatter outside off, he shoulders arms.
Loud, loud appeal for lbw, not given. Rohit does not take the review too. Wrong'un on the stumps, he looks for a flick, misses but the ball was probably heading down leg.

Ooh, that could have been curtains. Kohli was halfway down, and Faf was ball-watching. Fuller outside off, he mistimes his drive to the right of extra cover, where the fielder does not rein it in. If he had, that could have been very close.
Slightly short and wide, he pummels the cut to point
Googly outside off, he forces the ball through covers, gets a thick inside-edge towards the bowler
Straight as an arrow! Fuller on middle stump, he steps forward and thumps it past the bowler. No one moves.
Out comes the scoop and there goes the ball! Fuller-length ball on the stumps, he gets across and easily gets the ball over the fine leg fence. 17 off that Green over.
Off the backfoot and over covers! He is playing an absolute blinder, the RCB captain. Short of a length outside off, he clears his front leg again, and muscles Green over cover
Short of a length ball on middle that is flayed away in the gap between deep fine leg and deep backward square leg. Two runs taken
Banged in short, he goes for a pull and misses. He is pleading for a wide, not given.
TOP SHOT! All hands from Faf. Just clears his front leg and times the length ball exquisitely past mid-off. No stopping that
Good length ball outside off to start off, Kohli steps down just a touch and opens the face of the bat to punch it hard past point
Legbreak outside off, he pushes towards cover and they pinch a quick run
Another wrong'un from Chawla, who stays back and gets it to long off
Very quick googly on the stumps of Kohli, who punches to long on quite confidently
quicker length ball on the pads of the batter who clips it to deep square leg
Another googly from Chawla picked early by Kohli who dabs it to short third
Flatter outside off, he slaps it to extra cover where Rohit puts in a dive to his right and intercepts
Length on middle stump, he pushes to mid-on and sets off for a quick run
Another short ball into the body of du Plessis who looks for a hook, but does not time it as well with the ball going towards deep backward square leg
Back of a length ball outside off, he pats it to point
Oh, shot Kohli! Front foot pull of the highest order. Banged in short, 143kph, Kohli gets in position early and hammers it over midwicket. 50 up for RCB in the sixth over
Drives on the up but can't beat mid-off! But that was struck very crisply. Length outside off, he presents the full face of the bat.
Back of a length ball outside off, he cuts with soft hands to the point fielder. They take a run.
Oh, a seam-up ball from Chawla, 117.8 kph that is slapped to long on by du Plessis
Misses the off pole by a whisker!  Was there an edge as well? Nope, think it was just close to the stumps. Googly, not picked by du Plessis who looks for a hack through covers, misses
short, wide and du Plessis ain't missing out. Was quicker, 90.7 kph but du Plessis just stays back and hacks him through covers
Wrong'un outside off, he mistimes his cut to cover
flatter wrong'un on leg stump, he works to square leg
Flatter length ball on leg stump, he backs away looking for a pull, gets a thick inside edge to short fine leg.
Length outside off, he drives it crisply to covers
Chinnaswamy roars as Kohli hammers Archer all the way! Slower ball outside off that is spotted early by Kohli who jumps down the track and whacks him straight over long off for a six
Good length ball on off, he pats it to to cover
Pacy short of a length ball that beats Kohli all ends up. He is surprised by the length as he looks to loft it, and misses
Deft touch and Kohli gets four. Back of a length ball outside off, he gently opens the face of his bat to guide it past point

Puts Kohli down first ball! That would have been some start to his Mumbai career. Length ball outside off, Kohli backs away looking to blast it over mid-off, does not connect as well. Archer gets both hands to it but can't hold on
Goes for the scoop now, seeing the fine leg fielder in, but is unable to connect to the length ball that is on off stump
Length ball that raps du Plessis on the thigh pads as he looks to play it to the on-side
Even better! Slower length ball outside off, he jumps down the track and simply presents the full face of the blade to swing through the line over mid-off and eventually over the ropes.
BANG!  On a length on leg stump, he jumps down the track, gives himself room and effortlessly slams him over deep midwicket. Holds his shape so well, doe du Plessis.
Beaten! Length ball just outside off, he pokes at it and misses
IMPERIOUS! That's the shot of a man in confidence. In the slot, rather he made it into one by stepping down and backing away. Presents the full face of the bat and drives him through covers
Dances down the track does Kohli to the length ball on leg stump and absolutely pummels it but straight to mid-on
Ooh, gets good movement causing du Plessis to lose his footing. Full on the pads of the batter, who is swept off his feet
Some in-swing into Kohli but once again the line is on the pads. He clips it imperiously to deep backward square leg.
Shimmies down the track to the length ball outside off and mistimes to covers
Too straight and punished!  Full-length ball on the pads of Kohli, who effortlessly flicks it past a diving short fine leg for a four

Better line, and has Kohli in just a bit of trouble. On a length with a hint of shape into Kohli, who looks for a drive on the up, gets a thick inside-edge back onto the pads. Could have so easily sneaked back onto his stumps.
Fuller, but he strays down leg a third time. The umpire extends his arms again to call a wide.
Nerves? Seems so. Length ball now, there is some movement, but the line is once again down leg. Called a wide
A bit of movement but the line is down leg, and called a wide
On a length on middle stump, du Plessis pushes it back to the bowler

Length ball on middle and shaping into leg, he tucks it to the right of deep backward square leg and they take a couple of runs. Kishan flicks the ball back onto the stumps as the throw comes in but the batter had made it comfortably.
Again, just a hint of movement into Kohli, who walks towards the bowler a touch, defends to the left of the bowler and takes a quick run
Ooh, gets the length ball to shape into du Plessis, who presents the full face of the bat and drives past the bowler for a run
Length just outside off, not a lot of shape as du Plessis taps to point
On a length with a bit of shape away from Kohli, who opens the face of the bat and pats to point for a run
